# Keystone Prep Center

> Keystone Prep Center is an Amazon FBA prep center and 3PL (third-party logistics warehouse) in Lansdale, Pennsylvania, in the Philadelphia area. It preps inventory for Amazon FBA and ships Shopify, DTC and TikTok Shop orders for small and mid-size ecommerce brands. Also written as "Keystone Prep".

## Facts

- Legal name: Keystone Prep Center LLC
- Address: 805 West Fifth Street, Suite 10, Lansdale, PA 19446, United States
- Phone and text: 267-517-1112
- Email: hello@keystoneprepcenter.com
- Website: https://keystoneprepcenter.com
- Receiving hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Eastern
- Warehouse: 6,000 sq ft, dock-height door, lot takes full 53-foot trailers and 40-foot containers
- Clients ship in from anywhere in the US or overseas; most never visit the warehouse
- Every carton is photographed at check-in and clients follow their inventory in an online portal

## Services

- Amazon FBA prep: receiving, inspection, count verification, FNSKU labeling, polybagging, bundling, carton prep, outbound to any US Amazon fulfillment center
- Shopify, DTC and TikTok Shop fulfillment: pick and pack, orders placed by 2 PM ET ship the same day, Monday to Friday
- Container and pallet receiving
- Amazon FBA removal order processing: receive, sort, store, relabel and send back to FBA
- Storage on racks and pallets

## Pricing

- FBA prep, all-in per unit (receiving, inspection, FNSKU label, box prep): $0.70 under 500 units a month, $0.65 from 500 to 1,000, $0.60 from 1,001 to 5,000, $0.55 above 5,000
- First test shipment, up to 100 units, is free
- Shopify and DTC fulfillment: $3.50 per order plus $0.75 per additional item; $3.25 plus $0.50 from 500 orders a month; custom quote at 1,000+ orders a month
- Storage: from $35 per pallet per month
- Add-ons: polybagging $0.25 per unit, bubble wrap $0.40 per unit, bundling $0.50 per unit bundled
- No setup fees and no monthly minimums. $25 minimum per inbound shipment ($50 for container or trailer freight)

## Not a fit

- Hazmat, frozen or refrigerated goods, meltables, and oversize or very heavy freight
